name: Jewelry Business Spreadsheet
title: Jewelry Business Spreadsheet: Jewelry Pricing Calculator by Metal Weight, Findings Inventory, Custom Orders, Sales & Profit
etsy_title: Jewelry Pricing Calculator Spreadsheet, Handmade Jewelry Business, Silver & Gold Metal Cost, Custom Order Tracker, Inventory, Excel
description:
Price every necklace, ring and pair of earrings from its metal weight, findings and time, and see three prices side by side.

WHAT YOU GET
• Metal prices per troy ounce or gram: update once, every design re-prices
• Metal weight + waste %, findings, stones, chain by the inch
• 3 prices: classic jewelry formula, cost x multiplier, margin after Etsy fees
• Your price: profit, margin, profit per hour and a price check flag
• Custom orders: ring size, engraving, deposit, Due soon / Overdue
• Findings reorder flags, inventory, sales by channel, dashboard

INSIDE
Start Here guide, Dashboard, Settings (metal prices, rates, channel fees), Materials (150 findings & supplies), Product Pricing (100 designs), Stock In, Sales (1,500 rows), Expenses, Custom Orders (200), Inventory.

FILES
1 Excel file (.xlsx) that also works in Google Sheets (File > Import, or upload to Google Drive and open with Google Sheets). Works with Numbers on Mac with basic formatting.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy and download instantly from your Etsy Purchases page.
2. Open in Excel, or upload to Google Drive and open with Google Sheets.
3. Type your numbers in the yellow cells. Everything in green is calculated for you.

PLEASE NOTE
This is a DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Colours may look slightly different on screen and in print.
For use in your own business. Please don't share or resell the file. Prices and fee rates in the examples are illustrations: type in your own. Metal prices in the example are illustrations: use your supplier's current price.
Designed by our small studio with the help of digital and AI tools; every page and formula was planned, checked and tested by us.

Questions? Send us a message, we're happy to help.
